blocking_findings.finding: Production visibility is now genuinely IntersectionObserver-driven and setVisiblePages is no longer exposed, but the 200-page proof still does not measure the required invariant. It asserts the hook's cache-derived liveCanvasCount rather than counting actual nonzero canvas backing stores, and accepts eviction when only some old canvases are zeroed. Thus the test can pass without proving that every old-window backing canvas was evicted or that actual live canvases never exceeded 10.
blocking_findings.required_fix: During every controlled scroll window, count DOM canvases with width>0 and height>0 and assert the count is nonzero and <=10. Capture all canvases from the prior window and require every one to reach width=0 and height=0 after eviction; retain the existing nonzero near-window-start and no-eager-load assertions.

blocking_findings.finding: The retained TextLayer implementation now renders once, updates on zoom, and cancels on unmount, but the stale-work test is vacuous. It unmounts before the deferred text boundary and then merely iterates any instances that happen to exist; zero instances means zero assertions. It neither asserts that no stale DOM mutation occurred nor exercises identity replacement or a stale completion after TextLayer.render.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add non-vacuous deferred tests that capture the layer containers, force stale completion after page/text/render boundaries and after page/doc identity replacement, and assert no stale children/styles/navigation writes. Require construction/render/cancel counts explicitly so each intended async path is demonstrably exercised.
